title: Remove kehadiran fallback in tunjangan_jabatan multiplier
description: Replace attendanceDays fallback (hariKerja ?? kehadiran) with strict hariKerja usage. Apply formula tunjangan_jabatan = (tunjangan / 25) * hari_kerja by setting jabatanAmount = jabatanRateResolved * hariKerja. When hari_kerja=0, tunjangan_jabatan must be 0 (no silent inflation from kehadiran).

files.change: Remove attendanceDays variable and the kehadiran fallback. Use hariKerja directly at the 3 use sites (jabatanAmount, jabatanRate, masaKerjaRate). Apply (tunjangan/25)*hari_kerja = jabatanRateResolved * hariKerja. Guard remains: hariKerja > 0 before multiplication so null/zero yields 0.

implementation: Delete the kehadiran normalization and attendanceDays ternary at lines 255-257; keep only `const hariKerja = Math.max(0, toNumber(input.hariKerja));`
At line 268, replace `attendanceDays` with `hariKerja` in the jabatanAmountAuto multiplication: `(jabatanRateResolved as number) * hariKerja`
At line 281, replace `attendanceDays` with `hariKerja` in the jabatanRate divisor
At line 284, replace `attendanceDays` with `hariKerja` in the masaKerjaRate divisor (masaKerjaAmount is config-driven, only the rate denominator changes)
Verify null/undefined hariKerja resolves to 0 via Math.max(0, toNumber(...)) so no NaN leaks into the result
Confirm forced-zero path (shouldForceZeroJabatanRate) still short-circuits to 0 before reaching multiplication

reference.pattern: Service-internal math refactor with strict input contract; preserve public API shape
reference.examples: Use existing toNumber + Math.max(0, ...) defensive pattern; keep result object structure identical

criteria: Variable `attendanceDays` is removed from payrollAutoBufferService.ts (no occurrences remaining)
Variable `kehadiran` no longer participates in tunjangan_jabatan calculation (only read via input, never used as multiplier)
When hari_kerja=0 and kehadiran>0, calculateAutomaticValues returns jabatanAmount=0 (not silently inflated by kehadiran)
When hari_kerja>0, jabatanAmount = jabatanRateResolved * hari_kerja (equivalent to (tunjangan/25)*hari_kerja since rate is daily)
Public API surface unchanged: PayrollAutoBufferInput and PayrollAutoBufferResult field names/types identical
calculateVerificationValues still works for db_ptrj comparison path (uses hariKerja only, no kehadiran)
No new TypeScript errors; no regression in masaKerjaAmount (still config-driven lookup)

rationale.chosen_approach: Remove attendanceDays fallback entirely and use hariKerja at all 3 use sites
alternatives_considered: Keep attendanceDays but rename to clarify (rejected: still hides the bug if someone later adds another fallback)
Add a boolean flag to disable fallback per call (rejected: adds API surface, callers would need to know to set it)
Use hariKerja only in jabatanAmount, keep attendanceDays for rate display (rejected: rate denominator must match multiplier to be meaningful)
decision_factors: User explicitly confirmed strict hari_kerja with no fallback
Public API contract preservation (no caller changes needed)
Minimal diff (1 file modified, ~5 line changes)
Removes entire class of fallback bugs going forward
rationale.tradeoffs: Behavior change: callers that previously relied on the silent fallback (hari_kerja=0, kehadiran>0 yielding non-zero) will now see 0. Per user confirmation, this is the intended fix.

manual_checks: Run existing 6 tests in payrollAutoBufferService.test.ts — all must pass (they use hariKerja===kehadiran so unaffected)
Inspect calculateAutomaticValues output for sample input {jabatanText:'mandor panen', hariKerja:0, kehadiran:25, ...}: expect jabatanAmount=0 (was: 3500*25=87500 before fix)
Inspect calculateAutomaticValues output for {jabatanText:'mandor panen', hariKerja:20, kehadiran:25, ...}: expect jabatanAmount=3500*20=70000 (uses hariKerja, not the larger kehadiran)
success_metrics: Zero TypeScript compile errors after change
TASK-002 new test cases pass (2+ new edge-case tests)

risks.description: Caller services may have downstream code that depended on inflated values (e.g. aggregation_history seeded with old values)
risks.mitigation: Search callers (dataExtractorService, autoBufferManualAdjustmentSeederService) for hard-coded expectations; both consume the service result without further multiplication
risks.fallback: Re-run aggregation_history seeder after fix to refresh cached values

risks.description: Excel/HTML exports that recompute on-the-fly will see new values, but cached/stored exports (if any) retain old values
risks.mitigation: Per exploration findings, exports recompute live from the service; no cache layer identified
risks.fallback: Invalidate export cache or regenerate affected periods

key_functions.purpose: Compute auto-buffer values with strict hariKerja multiplier (no kehadiran fallback)
key_functions.returns: PayrollAutoBufferResult with jabatanAmount = jabatanRateResolved * hariKerja (or 0 when hariKerja=0)
